hotels.title: Modern Phuket Urban Glamour with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
hotels.description: Experience TRIBE, a stylish lifestyle escape by Accor, a short walk from Patong Beach and its famed nightlife - designed for discerning travellers craving Patong’s energy without the chaos. The space shines with neon lights, thoughtful pops of colour and ultra-sleek finishes, alongside a retro gaming corner in the airy lobby and two laid-back eateries that shape the social vibe. Find your calm away from Patong’s pace at the outdoor pool, elevated with submerged loungers, white marble accents and a pool bar close at hand. For dining, enjoy international favourites at 3 Uncles and a Barman, where open kitchens and a breezy terrace await. Make the most of your days in Patong, a bustling beach town on Phuket Island’s west coast, facing the sparkling Andaman Sea. After losing yourself in shopping, sunbathing and swimming, return for an hour of nightly free-flow cocktails and cheers to resort living.
